payload.text: Molt 1.4.1, hv 2026-11-04. Measured: pplr.bats red at 5c7aa30 and green at 8384180; the whole suite green under bash 5.3 and /bin/bash 3.2 at 8384180 (pplr-dc) and at 2fab7ac (vc, side by side, 650 of 650 each). Each landed tree equals its measured one outside intent/, where issue 0086's four records are the only addition, which no test reads. Next, hv's hand cut in ~/Devel/prj/Molt: git tag -a v1.4.1 bf441ba; git push upstream main v1.4.1 && git push local main v1.4.1; CI green on main and on the tag; tools/formula publish. Then the molt run on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs (todo 14). pplr-dc's banked branches issue-0086, issue-0086-red and release-1.4.1 go once the sleeves have run 1.4.1.
